name: t_tip_A
goal: Tip the box up to vertical with both grippers (one presses down, the other lifts) - raw WALLX.
setup: IQBAR flat on the table, arms at rest.
instruction: use both arms to stand the box up on its end: one gripper presses down on one end of the box while the other gripper lifts the opposite end up, until the box stands vertical
